name: inventory-visual-responsive
description: Validate the desktop Inventory toolbar at the reported 1277 px viewport plus narrow-phone rendered bounds at UI scales 0.8, 1, and 1.2, bounded compact controls, 44 px touch targets, category hover/focus feedback, selected-state precedence, and clean modal chrome.

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local S=game:GetService('StudioDeviceSimulatorService') local n='Inventory Visual QA Desktop 1277x720' local id for _,x in ipairs(S:GetDeviceListAsync()) do if S:GetDeviceInfoAsync(x).Name==n then id=x break end end local c={Name=n,Width=1277,Height=720,PixelDensity=96,DeviceForm=Enum.DeviceForm.Desktop} if id then S:UpdateDeviceAsync(id,c) else id=S:CreateDeviceAsync(c) end S:SetDeviceAsync(id) S:SetScalingModeAsync(Enum.DeviceSimulatorScalingMode.FitToWindow) task.wait(.3) local r=S:GetResolutionAsync() return H:JSONEncode({width=r.X,height=r.Y,active=S:GetDeviceAsync()==id})

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local c=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation c:Invoke('Reset') local a=c:Invoke('GrantPet',{name='Forest Pup',stars=1}) local b=c:Invoke('GrantPet',{name='Miner Cat',stars=1}) return H:JSONEncode({ok=a.ok==true and b.ok==true,first=a.ok,second=b.ok})

steps.label: seed two normal pets for deterministic composition

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:WaitForChild('PunchWallHUD') local a=g:WaitForChild('PunchWallClientAutomation') a:Invoke('OpenInventory') task.wait(.35) local r=g.GameMenu.FunctionalInventory local w=r.InventoryWindow local b=w.InventoryBody local p=b.InventoryGridPane local t=p.InventoryToolbar local s=t.InventorySearch local f=t.RarityFilter local c=t.InventoryCapacity local function overlap(x,y) local xp,xs,yp,ys=x.AbsolutePosition,x.AbsoluteSize,y.AbsolutePosition,y.AbsoluteSize return xp.X<yp.X+ys.X and xp.X+xs.X>yp.X and xp.Y<yp.Y+ys.Y and xp.Y+xs.Y>yp.Y end local function inside(x,y) local xp,xs,yp,ys=x.AbsolutePosition,x.AbsoluteSize,y.AbsolutePosition,y.AbsoluteSize return xp.X>=yp.X-1 and xp.Y>=yp.Y-1 and xp.X+xs.X<=yp.X+ys.X+1 and xp.Y+xs.Y<=yp.Y+ys.Y+1 end local controlsOk=s.AbsoluteSize.X>=160 and math.min(s.AbsoluteSize.Y,f.AbsoluteSize.X,f.AbsoluteSize.Y,c.AbsoluteSize.X,c.AbsoluteSize.Y)>=44 local bounded=inside(s,t) and inside(f,t) and inside(c,t) and not overlap(s,f) and not overlap(s,c) and not overlap(f,c) local attrs=t:GetAttribute('InventoryToolbarNoOverlap')==true and s:GetAttribute('InventoryReadableWidth')==true and (r:GetAttribute('InventorySearchExpectedWidth') or 0)>=160 and r:GetAttribute('InventorySearchReadable')==true return H:JSONEncode({ok=controlsOk and bounded and attrs,searchWidth=s.AbsoluteSize.X,searchHeight=s.AbsoluteSize.Y,rarityWidth=f.AbsoluteSize.X,capacityWidth=c.AbsoluteSize.X,bounded=bounded,toolbarNoOverlap=t:GetAttribute('InventoryToolbarNoOverlap'),searchReadable=s:GetAttribute('InventoryReadableWidth'),expected=r:GetAttribute('InventorySearchExpectedWidth'),capacityMode=c:GetAttribute('InventoryCapacityTextMode'),capacityFull=c:GetAttribute('InventoryCapacityFullText')})

steps.label: desktop search stays readable and every toolbar control is bounded

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local G=game:GetService('GuiService') local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation local r=g.GameMenu.FunctionalInventory local bar=r.InventoryWindow.InventoryBody.CategoryBar local fists=bar.CategoryFists local idle=fists:GetAttribute('InventoryVisualState') G.SelectedObject=fists task.wait(.15) local hover=fists:GetAttribute('InventoryVisualState') local hoveredCategory=r:GetAttribute('InventoryHoveredCategory') a:Invoke('SelectInventoryCategory','Fists') task.wait(.15) local selected=fists:GetAttribute('InventoryVisualState') G.SelectedObject=nil task.wait(.1) local selectedAfterFocus=fists:GetAttribute('InventoryVisualState') a:Invoke('SelectInventoryCategory','All') task.wait(.1) local final=fists:GetAttribute('InventoryVisualState') return H:JSONEncode({ok=idle=='Idle' and hover=='Hovered' and hoveredCategory=='Fists' and selected=='Selected' and selectedAfterFocus=='Selected' and final=='Idle' and r:GetAttribute('InventoryCategoryConnectionCount')==25,idle=idle,hover=hover,hoveredCategory=hoveredCategory,selected=selected,selectedAfterFocus=selectedAfterFocus,final=final,connections=r:GetAttribute('InventoryCategoryConnectionCount')})

steps.label: narrow phone stays bounded and touch safe across every supported UI scale
capture narrow Inventory at 120 percent scale

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local S=game:GetService('StudioDeviceSimulatorService') pcall(function() S:StopSimulationAsync() end) local names={['Inventory Visual QA Desktop 1277x720']=true,['Inventory Visual QA Phone 568x320']=true} local removed=0 for _,id in ipairs(S:GetDeviceListAsync()) do local info=S:GetDeviceInfoAsync(id) if names[info.Name] and info.IsCustom then S:RemoveDeviceAsync(id) removed+=1 end end return H:JSONEncode({default=S:GetDeviceAsync()=='default',removed=removed})

steps.label: restore default viewport and remove both custom devices

args.code: local S=game:GetService('StudioDeviceSimulatorService') pcall(function() S:StopSimulationAsync() end) local names={['Inventory Visual QA Desktop 1277x720']=true,['Inventory Visual QA Phone 568x320']=true} for _,id in ipairs(S:GetDeviceListAsync()) do local info=S:GetDeviceInfoAsync(id) if names[info.Name] and info.IsCustom then pcall(function() S:RemoveDeviceAsync(id) end) end end return true
